examples.sentence: 小孩子就喜欢打打闹闹，磕磕碰碰是难免的，过几天就好了， 别担心。
examples.romanization: xiǎoháizi jiù xǐhuan dǎ dǎ nào nào， kē kēpèng pèng shì nánmiǎn de， guò jǐtiān jiù hǎole， bié dānxīn。
examples.translation: Children like to make a lot of noise. It's inevitable to bump into each other. It'll be all right in a few days. Don't worry.

pattern: 左 # M N 右 # M N
title: 左 # M N 右 # M N (one N after another)
longExplanation: one N after another. Pinyin: zuǒ # M N yòu # M N
formation: zuǒ # M N yòu # M N

examples.sentence: 妈妈左一个电话右一个电话地催他回家。
examples.romanization: māma zuǒ yī gè diànhuà yòu yī gè diànhuà dì cuī tā huíjiā。
examples.translation: Mother called him left and right (lit. with one call after another), trying to hurry him to come home.

title: 莫非/难道 …… 不成 (could it be that)
longExplanation: could it be that. Pinyin: mòfēi/ nándào …… bùchéng

examples.sentence: 他大吃一惊，头脑中一片空白——莫非受了骗不成?
examples.romanization: tā dàchīyījīng， tóunǎo zhōng yīpiàn kòngbái—— mòfēi shòu le piàn bùchéng?
examples.translation: He was shocked and his mind was blank - could he possibly be deceived?

title: 一个 N (with a…)
longExplanation: with a…. Pinyin: yī gè N

examples.sentence: 他手没抓住栏杆，一个跟头栽了下来。
examples.romanization: tā shǒu méi zhuāzhù lángān， yī gè gēntou zāi le xiàlai。
examples.translation: He missed the railing and fell with a flip.

title: (了) 个 A (to the extent that it became A)
shortExplanation: to the extent that it became A
longExplanation: to the extent that it became A. Pinyin: ( le) gè A

examples.sentence: 他把心爱的琴摔了个粉碎。
examples.romanization: tā bǎ xīn'ài de qín shuāi le gè fěnsuì。
examples.translation: He smashed his beloved violin to pieces (lit. to the extent that it became shattered).

title: 向来 V/A (always have (been) V/A)
longExplanation: always have (been) V/A. Pinyin: xiànglái V/A

examples.sentence: 他们向来忠厚、老实，为人诚恳。
examples.romanization: tāmen xiànglái zhōnghòu、 lǎoshi， wéirén chéngkěn。
examples.translation: They have always been loyal, honest and sincere.

examples.sentence: 大家预先都没有想到，本届绘画展览竟然这么受欢迎。
examples.romanization: dàjiā yùxiān dōu méiyǒu xiǎngdào， běnjiè huìhuà zhǎnlǎn jìngrán zhème shòuhuānyíng。
examples.translation: It was never expected (ahead of time) that this painting exhibition would be so popular.

pattern: CLAUSE1 也好 CLAUSE2 也罢
title: CLAUSE1 也好 CLAUSE2 也罢 (it doesn’t matter whether CLAUSE1 or CLAUSE2)
shortExplanation: it doesn’t matter whether CLAUSE1 or CLAUSE2
longExplanation: it doesn’t matter whether CLAUSE1 or CLAUSE2. Pinyin: CLAUSE1 yě hǎo CLAUSE2 yěbà

examples.sentence: 开汽车也好，骑自行车也罢，行进中打电话都会影响注意力与反应能力。
examples.romanization: kāi qìchē yě hǎo， qí zìxíngchē yěbà， xíngjìn zhōng dǎdiànhuà dūhuì yǐngxiǎng zhùyìlì yǔ fǎnyìng nénglì。
examples.translation: It doesn’t matter whether [you are] driving a car or riding a bicycle, making phone calls during the journey can affect attention and reaction ability.

title: 不时 (from time to time)
longExplanation: from time to time. Pinyin: bùshí

examples.sentence: 不时传来的几声鸟叫提醒我们，新的一天又开始了。
examples.romanization: bùshí chuánlái de jǐ shēng niǎo jiào tíxǐng wǒmen， xīn de yī tiān yòu kāishǐ le。
examples.translation: A few bird calls from time to time remind us that a new day has begun.

examples.sentence: 他的话多多少少有些真实。
examples.translation: What he said was more or less truthful.

title: 逐 M (one by one)
longExplanation: one by one. Pinyin: zhú M

examples.sentence: 雨季快到了，水库要逐个检查，以排除安全隐患。
examples.romanization: yǔjì kuài dàoliǎo， shuǐkù yào zhúgè jiǎnchá， yǐ páichú ānquán yǐnhuàn。
examples.translation: As the rainy season is approaching, reservoirs should be inspected one by one to eliminate potential safety hazards.

examples.sentence: 运动健身归根到底是自己的事，胡乱对付其实是在骗自己。
examples.romanization: yùndòng jiànshēn guīgēndàodǐ shì zìjǐ de shì， húluàn duìfu qíshí shì zài piàn zìjǐ。
examples.translation: Exercise and fitness is after all [your] own business. If you just try to scrape through it, you are actually deceiving yourself.

examples.sentence: 您放心，我们 一定会尽全力抢救病人，哪怕只有一线希望。
examples.romanization: nín fàngxīn， wǒmen yīdìng huì jìn quánlì qiǎngjiù bìngrén， nǎpà zhǐyǒu yīxiànxīwàng。
examples.translation: You can rest assured that we will do our best to save the patients, even if there is only a glimmer of hope.

examples.sentence: 经济发展了，百姓的收入增加了，消费能力就强，反之，百姓的消费能力就差。
examples.romanization: jīngjìfāzhǎn le， bǎixìng de shōurù zēngjiā le， xiāofèi nénglì jiù qiáng， fǎnzhī， bǎixìng de xiāofèi nénglì jiù chà。
examples.translation: If the economy develops, people's income increases, and their buying power increases. On the contrary [if the opposite is true], people's buying power will be less.

pattern: V/A1 的 V/A1，V/A2 的 V/A2
title: V/A1 的 V/A1，V/A2 的 V/A2 (some V/A1, some V/A2)
longExplanation: some V/A1, some V/A2. Pinyin: V/A1 de V/A1，V/A2 de V/A2

examples.sentence: 进了果园，大家看到一树的桃 ，红的红，绿的绿，漂亮极了。
examples.romanization: jìn le guǒyuán， dàjiā kàn dào yī shù de táo ， hóng de hóng， lǜ de lǜ， piàoliang jíle。
examples.translation: Entering the orchard, you can see a tree of peaches, some red, some green, very beautiful.
